taskNotes.mrcr: OpenAI's multi-round coreference test: return the n-th of eight near-identical asks in a long chat. Lengths the model's context can't hold score zero.
taskNotes.graphwalks: OpenAI's multi-hop graph test: BFS and parent queries over edge lists of 8k to 64k tokens.
taskNotes.tools: Multi-step episodes against a simulated workspace, graded by the end state rather than the exact calls.
